title: Capturing Perspectives of Crowdsourced Annotators in Subjective Learning Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Statistical Parity to measure the disparity in prediction accuracy between annotators who frequently align with the majority opinion and those in the minority group (defined as the lowest 25th percentile of annotators in terms of similarity to the majority vote).

Calculating Statistical Parity to measure the disparity in prediction accuracy between prolific annotators and sparse annotators (defined as the lowest 25th percentile of annotators in terms of the number of their contributions).
